title: Phone unboxing: Samsung Galaxy A56
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 unboxing ad for a phone shop in Rwanda. Setting: a clean desk in a bright Kigali phone shop. Light: cool, crisp studio light. Music: modern electronic beat.
The Samsung Galaxy A56 must look exactly as in Image 1: same shape, colours, logo and label.
0-2s: Overhead top-down shot, locked-off static camera: hands slide a sealed box onto the desk. Sound: cardboard on wood.
2-4s: First-person POV shot, hands in frame, static camera: thumbs lift the lid and the Samsung Galaxy A56 from Image 1 is revealed inside. Sound: the lid sliding off, a soft click.
4-8s: Close-up, slow push-in: a hand lifts the Samsung Galaxy A56 out and tilts it so the light runs along its edges.
8-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, slow orbit around the subject: the Samsung Galaxy A56 standing on the desk, slow and clean. A warm voice-over says in English: "Genuine with 12-month warranty."
No on-screen text or added logos.

storyboard.notice: Preview: Seedance arrives with the BytePlus key. This is the shot plan Seedance will film; no credits were taken.
